note: Three short clips for the October coach forum. Same pipeline, same voice (George), same music bed as the reports film. Recorded as ONE continuous timeline and cut into three at assembly.

lines.text: A county place starts with one invitation, sent to one family.
lines.shot: The invitation email opening on a phone

lines.text: It opens on a single page: every session, the venue, the coaches, and one price for the whole season.
lines.shot: Booking page on desktop, scrolling the session list

lines.text: They accept and pay by card. The place is confirmed the moment the payment clears. No forms, no bank transfers, no chasing.
lines.shot: Accept and pay, then the confirmed state

lines.text: And on the county's side, that place, that payment and that player land in one ledger the moment it happens.
lines.shot: Admin ledger: the new row and the totals moving

lines.text: Suffolk Tennis. Sign in at suffolktennis dot online.
Every paid place comes with its own QR ticket, one for each session.
lines.shot: Parent Hub ticket with the QR code

lines.text: The coach scans it at the door. Green means admitted, and the register marks them arrived, with the time.
lines.shot: Coach scanner, green result, register row flipping to Arrived

lines.text: A second scan says already here. A place that has not been paid for is turned away.
lines.shot: Duplicate scan, then a rejected scan

lines.text: So the coach knows exactly who is on court, and nobody is working from a clipboard.
Suffolk Tennis. Sign in at suffolktennis dot online.
Every session a child is booked onto fills their timetable on its own.
lines.shot: Sporting Timetable with Suffolk sessions already in it

lines.text: Their week, their term, and their hours against the LTA target, without anyone typing a date.
lines.shot: Week to month view, hours bar against target

lines.text: One tap adds a session to the family calendar.
lines.shot: Add to calendar from a booking

lines.text: Parents stop asking when and where. Coaches stop answering the same question twenty times.
lines.shot: Parent Hub bookings, next session card

lines.text: Suffolk Tennis. Sign in at suffolktennis dot online.
